mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS item_id, 'QUESTION' AS kind, v.title, q.status, v.id AS version_id, v.version_number, LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.prompt_json, '$.prompt')), 2000) AS body, 'QUESTION' AS reference_kind, NULL AS attachment_revision FROM question q JOIN question_version v ON v.owner_id = q.owner_id AND v.question_id = q.id AND v.id = q.current_version_id WHERE q.owner_id = #{owner} AND q.id IN #{id} ORDER BY q.id

SELECT id AS item_id, 'ATTACHMENT' AS kind, file_name AS title, status, NULL AS version_id, 0 AS version_number, LEFT(description, 2000) AS body, 'ATTACHMENT' AS reference_kind, revision AS attachment_revision FROM material_attachment WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND status = 'READY' AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_attachment WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'READY' AND revision >= #{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_board_external_reference (owner_id, board_id, board_revision, reference_kind, item_id, version_id, attachment_revision) VALUES (#{owner}, #{boardId}, #{revision}, #{reference.referenceKind}, #{reference.itemId}, #{reference.versionId}, #{reference.attachmentRevision})
